title: Urine Collection Procedure for the analysis of extracellular RNA
protocol: Process the sample within 2 hours of collection.
Collect approximately 50 ml urine in an empty sterile urine collection cup as a midstream sample.
Transfer urine to a 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 500 xg for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the urine to a fresh 50 ml centrifuge tube, avoiding any material at the bottom of the previous tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 2000 xg for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the top 80% of the urine, avoiding any material at the bottom of the tube, to fresh 15 ml tubes, dispensing at most 10 ml urine per tube (should be 4 tubes total).
Using a sterile pipet, make 3 aliquots of 1 ml each in screw-cap microcentrifuge tubes.
Place the four 15 ml centrifuge tubes and three 1 ml aliquots of urine into a -80°C freezer for storage.
